question.text: Time-based rebalancing in PMS refers to:

answer.text: Rebalancing at fixed calendar intervals (e.g., quarterly, annually)

explanation.text: The Logic: Time-based uses calendar triggers, independent of drift. The Trap: Crash-only or tax-based triggers are not time-based. Cross-Exam Context: Same framework in X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Annual rebalancing with mid-year drift check balances cost and discipline.
